faqs.q: Why is the design fee shown separately?
faqs.a: Because design is real work that happens before a single panel is cut, and it should not be buried inside a build rate where you cannot see it. On Signature and Atelier projects the design fee is credited against build cost when you proceed with us.

faqs.q: What causes a quote to move?
faqs.a: Almost always one of three things: a change in area, a change in material grade, or an unforeseen existing condition discovered once openings are made. The first two are your decisions; the third is covered by the contingency line we show you openly.
